entries: A seed wakes up and sprouts: the seed rests in the soil, and with water, warmth and light it wakes up, growing a root down and a green shoot up into a seedling.
slots.label: A seed wakes up
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: Watch out: the flower is not the end of the plant: the seedling grows into an adult plant with a flower, and inside the flower new seeds are forming, ready to start the cycle again.
slots.label: The flower and new seeds
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: An egg hatches into a caterpillar: a butterfly lays tiny eggs on a leaf, and each egg hatches into a caterpillar that munches leaves and grows bigger.
slots.label: An egg hatches
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: The butterfly emerges and the cycle repeats: the caterpillar rests inside a pupa while its body changes, then an adult butterfly emerges and lays eggs, so the cycle repeats.
slots.label: The butterfly emerges
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

entries: The start of a plant's life: it rests in the soil and wakes up with water, warmth and light, then sprouts a root and a shoot.
slots.label: Seed
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The baby plant that has just sprouted from a seed: it grows taller and stronger until it becomes an adult plant.
slots.label: Seedling
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The showy part of the adult plant: new seeds form inside it, so it starts the next round of the cycle instead of ending it.
slots.label: Flower
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The growing-up stage of a butterfly: it hatches from an egg and munches leaves to grow bigger.
slots.label: Caterpillar
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The resting case a caterpillar forms: inside it, the caterpillar's body changes into a butterfly.
slots.label: Pupa
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

entries: The circle of changes a living thing goes through as it grows: the adult makes new young, and the circle starts again.
slots.label: Life cycle
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.
